narr: A cold front swept from northwest to southeast across Arkansas which initiated strong to severe thunderstorms ahead of the line. Of these storms, some would reach severe criteria producing a swath of wind damage and numerous instances of flash flooding across the state of Arkansas.
ev: Numerous locations along Arkansas Highway 124 were underwater and impassable between Damascus and Quitman.
Water covered the intersection of Cherry Street and Cravens Street near Spadra Creek in the town of Clarksville.
Multiple streets covered by high water south of Clinton in Cleburne county.
High water completely covered the intersection of Maumelle Blvd and the interchange of I-430, just west of the interstate bridge in North Little Rock.
High water covered several roads in downtown Conway.

Several locations were impassable along Arkansas Highway 38 due to high water with several cars stranded within the high water. No injuries reported regarding the vehicles which drove into the high water.
